Recipe outline: Portable Porridge  (Porridge Toast)
120g Oat flour
25g Wheat gluten
75g Rolled oats
30g Oat bran
225ml Milk, slightly warmed
7g Yeast
10g Sugar
10g Unsalted butter, melted
3g Salt

Mix the oat flour and gluten thorougly
Add & mix all the other ingredients
Stir thoroughly for 5 minutes
Pour into an oiled tin, put in a warm place
Wait until doubled in size
Bake at 200C (Fan oven) for 35 minutes
